spec.description: One server of the radar data distribution network, and its health.

server_id.description: Server name, such as `ldm1`. `radar.list_servers` returns it as `id`.

reportingHost.description: Monitoring host to report from: `rdss` or `tdss` on 2026-10-01. Without it, the service picks one; any other value answers 404.

response.description: The server. The same record `radar.list_servers` lists, with no wrapper.
